notes.title: Bug Fixes 2
notes.content:
Hi guys,

I believe I've now fixed the bug some people were experiencing with rendering of the killerbee/hornets!

I've also made some changes to optimize performance and improve enemies.

Hoping to get time later this week to work on the survival mode feature.

notes.title: Bug Fixes 1
notes.content: Fixed bug causing weapons to stop firing

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hi Guys, I've just patched an issue some people were experiencing where the weapons stop firing.

Next I'll be working on a bug where the dog enemies occasionally get stuck in their biting animation after dying, optimizing the 3rd level which can be laggy on some systems and any other bugs that arise before building a survival mode. Any other bugs or suggestions please let me know.

notes.title: The Hell Hives - Release This Thursday April 29th
notes.content:
The Hell Hives will release for PC this Thursday April 29th. 

I'll be working on a series of free updates for the game in the coming months, including a survival mode. Please let me know of any additional features you'd like to see included or any other suggestions.
